clf-avc-051.text: A retail company is adopting AWS and needs to organize accounts, define governance policies, and manage billing centrally across subsidiaries. Which AWS service is the foundational service for this multi-account governance model?
clf-avc-051.explanation: AWS Organizations provides centralized multi-account management, account grouping through OUs, governance with SCPs, and consolidated billing.
clf-avc-051.hint: Think of the service that creates the hierarchy of management and member accounts.
optionRationales: Organizations is the multi-account governance foundation.

clf-avc-052.text: A company wants to prevent member AWS accounts from creating resources outside approved Regions while still allowing local administrators broad permissions inside approved Regions. Which mechanism should enforce the organization-wide restriction?
options: A Service Control Policy (SCP) in AWS Organizations
clf-avc-052.explanation: SCPs define maximum permission guardrails for accounts in AWS Organizations and can restrict API actions or Regions even when local IAM policies are broad.
clf-avc-052.hint: The restriction must apply above individual IAM administrators at the organization level.
optionRationales: Bucket policies apply only to specific S3 resources.
Dashboards observe metrics but do not enforce permissions.

clf-avc-053.text: A video streaming company needs to deliver very low latency media content to users located in a large metropolitan area that is very far away from any major region of the AWS. Traffic requires that specific computing services (such as EC2) they physically turn very close to final customers in that city to process data in milliseconds of a digit. AWS solves this problem without requiring the creation of a new region?
clf-avc-053.explanation: The AWS Local Zones put computer services, storage and database very close to large urban or industrial centers, allowing to extend the resources of the cloud to deliver latency of milliseconds of a digit to local end users.
clf-avc-053.hint: Think of the service that follows the trail of API actions.
optionRationales: The AWS Local Zones put computer services, storage and database very close to large urban or industrial centers, allowing to extend the resources of the cloud to deliver latency of milliseconds of a digit to local end users.
The Edge Locations are used by CloudFront to make static and dynamic content caches globally, but not for running instances EC2 complete or custom processing close to the customer.
Inspector scans supported workloads for vulnerabilities.

The AWS Outposts extends the services of the AWS for within the physical local data center owned by the customer himself (on-premises), and not for an infrastructure distributed by the AWS in a common urban area.

clf-avc-054.text: During mapping of an inventory of 50 local corporate servers, the migration team has identified an old customized proprietary payroll system that runs on an obsolete operating system that no longer has technical support and whose original installers have been lost. The software perfectly serves the company and will not be modified. The team decides to generate an identical disk image of this server and import it directly to instances EC2 the AWS, without changing any line of code or architecture. '6 Rs' describes this action?
clf-avc-054.explanation: AWS Config records configuration changes for supported resources and evaluates them against rules to determine compliance over time.
clf-avc-054.hint: The requirement is about resource configuration state, not simply who called an API.
optionRationales: Replatforming involves doing small infrastructure optimizations (such as moving a local database to Amazon RDS managed) without changing the main code, which was not the case of the direct migration described.

clf-avc-055.text: A company wants to discover sensitive personally identifiable information stored in Amazon S3 and receive findings when such data appears unexpectedly. Which managed AWS service is designed for this purpose?
options: Edge Locations of the Amazon CloudFront.
clf-avc-055.explanation: Amazon Macie uses machine learning and pattern matching to discover and help protect sensitive data stored in Amazon S3.
clf-avc-055.hint: Think of the AWS data-security service specialized in sensitive information inside S3.
optionRationales: Edge Locations are global presence points for file cache and peripheral network security, not serving to host and execute redundant three-layer application servers.

The AWS Direct Connect is a network solution that establishes a dedicated and private connection between the customer's local data center and the AWS, without relation to the balancing of internal servers of the application.

clf-avc-056.text: A multinational corporation has a set of legacy accounting systems in its local data centers on-premises. The lease agreement of the data center building expires in 30 In view of the severe time restriction, the technical team decides to migrate all the servers to the AWS without any structural changes in applications. AWS Well-Architected Framework can be temporarily compromised on the first cloud day to prioritize migration speed?
clf-avc-056.explanation: Amazon GuardDuty continuously analyzes supported security telemetry and threat intelligence to identify potentially malicious or unauthorized activity.
clf-avc-056.hint: Think of the AWS managed threat-detection guard.
optionRationales: GuardDuty detects threats from security telemetry.

clf-avc-057.text: A software company manages a private cloud corporate platform on dedicated local servers. The financial team notes that the cost to maintain this infrastructure is fixed and high, regardless of whether 10 or 10.000 users logged in. They want to move the load to AWS so that the cost faithfully accompanies the seasonal fluctuations of business use. What advantage of the cloud AWS describes this ability to align operational costs with actual demand?
clf-avc-057.explanation: AWS Secrets Manager securely stores application secrets and supports managed rotation workflows for supported credentials.
clf-avc-057.hint: The requirement centers on secure secret storage and automated rotation.
optionRationales: Secrets Manager is designed for secrets and rotation.

clf-avc-058.text: A company needs centralized control over cryptographic keys used to encrypt data across AWS services and wants key policies and CloudTrail auditing. Which service should it use?
options: Edge Locations associated with the same Target Group.
Local Zones connected to the same public sub-network.
clf-avc-058.explanation: AWS KMS provides centralized creation and management of cryptographic keys, integrates with many AWS services, and supports access policies and auditing.
clf-avc-058.hint: Think of the managed service whose name explicitly refers to key management.
optionRationales: Edge Locations do not store complete copies of persistent databases or persistent files from corporate file systems, serving only for transient cache.
The Local Zones extend services to metropolitan areas close to the region of origin, suffering from the same geographical risks concentrated in case of massive environmental disasters in the area.
